text:
Ava Summers: Quick run-through for the April launch + webinar. We need keywords, JSON-LD, internal linking, redirects for moved docs, and GTM/form fields. Can we divvy up?
Jon Park: Ill take keywords + meta templates. Goal: 1 primary + 2 long-tail per page. Sheet by Wed.
Lydia Moss: Ill author WebinarEvent + FAQPage JSON-LD and run Rich Results tests. Will post screenshots.
Ethan Cole: Redirects are on me. There are four legacy pages moved to /docs/platform. Ill prepare CSV + Netlify/NGINX examples and stage as 302 then flip.
Ava Summers: @Jon include UTM examples (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign). @Lydia mirror FAQ answers to landing copy. @Ethan add curl status checks in PR.
Jon Park: Keywords: landing primary "low-latency LLM inference"; supports "inference latency optimization", "LLM serving best practices". Webinar: "LLM serving webinar", long-tail "reduce inference cost".
Lydia Moss: Draft JSON-LD snippet for staging: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Running LLMs in Production","startDate":"2026-04-07T16:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/llm-inference"},"offers":{"@type":"Offer","url":"https://redwood.ai/register"}}
Ethan Cole: NGINX example: rewrite ^/docs/old-guide/?$ /docs/platform/new-guide/ permanent;
Ava Summers: GTM/form: hidden field campaign=llm_launch_apr2026, fire event webinar_signup. SalesOps: pass lead_source and utm_content when from benchmark blog.
seo-bot: After schema is live on staging, run Structured Data test and Lighthouse; post results.
Ava Summers: Owners & deadlines: Jon -> keywords by Wed (1764075600). Lydia -> schema + tests by Mon (1764208400). Ethan -> redirects CSV + PR by Fri EOD (1764142000). Review meeting after assets are in. Ping here for blockers.
